🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
power计算 x 的 y 次方

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 volume：volume
  3. 计算 safe_close：close.where(close > 0.0)
  4. 计算 prev_close：safe_close.shift(1)
  5. 计算 safe_volume：volume.where(volume > 0.0)
  6. 计算 ret：(safe_close / prev_close - 1.0)
  7. 计算 dollar_volume：(prev_close * safe_volume)
  8. 计算 impact：(ret.abs() / dollar_volume)
  9. 计算 impact_base：impact.滚动窗口(30, min_periods=15).median()
  10. 计算 impact_base：impact_base.where(np.isfinite(impact_base) & (impact_base > 0.0))
  11. 计算 relative_impact：(impact / impact_base).clip(upper=10.0)
  12. 计算 downside：ret.clip(upper=0.0).pow(2) * relative_impact
  13. 计算 upside：ret.clip(lower=0.0).pow(2) * relative_impact
  14. 计算 asymmetry：downside.滚动窗口(30, min_periods=15).mean() - upside.滚动窗口(30, min_periods=15).mean()
  15. 计算 total_stress：(downside + upside).滚动窗口(30, min_periods=15).mean()
  16. 计算 raw_signal：(asymmetry / total_stress)
  17. 计算 factor：raw_signal.ewm(span=30, min_periods=15, adjust=False).mean()

  2. MA30(r^+_t^2 I_t) — MA30(x) → 30 期均线

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_impact_weighted_asymmetry_slow_30(df): """Slower normalized downside-impact asymmetry ">class="kw">for predictive stability.""" df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["close"] volume = df_copy["volume"] safe_close = close.where(close > 0.0) prev_close = safe_close.shift(1) safe_volume = volume.where(volume > 0.0) ret = (safe_close / prev_close - 1.0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) dollar_volume = (prev_close * safe_volume).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) impact = (ret.abs() / dollar_volume).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) impact_base = impact.rolling(30, min_periods=15).median() impact_base = impact_base.where(np.isfinite(impact_base) & (impact_base > 0.0)) relative_impact = (impact / impact_base).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).clip(upper=10.0) downside = ret.clip(upper=0.0).pow(2) * relative_impact upside = ret.clip(lower=0.0).pow(2) * relative_impact asymmetry = downside.rolling(30, min_periods=15).mean() - upside.rolling(30, min_periods=15).mean() total_stress = (downside + upside).rolling(30, min_periods=15).mean() raw_signal = (asymmetry / total_stress.replace(0.0, np.nan)).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) factor = raw_signal.ewm(span=30, min_periods=15, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean() df_copy["factor_impact_weighted_asymmetry_slow_30"] = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_impact_weighted_asymmetry_slow_30"]
